Key features include a wide variety of art styles to choose from, real-time preview options, and the ability to adjust the level of style transfer. It is ideal for artists, designers, and anyone looking to add a creative twist to their photography. Pros include its ease of use, high-quality results, and the ability to experiment with different art styles. Limitations may include the need for a stable internet connection and the potential for less control over the final output compared to traditional painting techniques.

tools.detail: GIMP, standing for GNU Image Manipulation Program, is a free and open-source image editor that offers a range of AI features. It is a powerful tool for photo editing, graphic design, and image manipulation, providing users with a comprehensive set of tools and effects. GIMP includes features like layers, masks, and brushes, as well as AI-driven tools for tasks like object removal and content-aware fill. It is suitable for both beginners and advanced users, and it is particularly appealing to those who prefer open-source software. Pros include its affordability, extensive feature set, and active community support. Limitations may include a steeper learning curve compared to some paid alternatives and occasional performance issues with complex projects.

tools.name: GIMP AI
tools.desc: AI plugins for GIMP image editing
pros: Free and open source, transparent code, self-hostable for full data control
Supports local / Docker deployment, better data privacy
Free version available, zero cost for personal use
cons: Requires some technical skill to deploy and configure
usage:
Step: Check your environment
This tool runs locally. First make sure your computer meets the basics.
Tip:
Install the required runtime (see README).
Check:
Open a terminal and type `the command`. If you see a version number, your environment is OK.

Step: Download the code to your machine
Open a terminal in a folder you like and run the commands below:
Code:
git clone https://github.com/aiotools/gimp-ai.git
cd gimp-ai
Tip:
New to git? If it says command not found, download it from https://git-scm.com.

Step: Install dependencies
The project needs some extra building blocks to run.
Code:
make install
Tip:
If a command errors, it is usually a network issue. Python users can try a mirror.

Step: Fill in the API Key / account config
Many AI tools need a model connection. Find the config item in the README and fill it in.
Code:
# Example: replace xxx with your real Key
export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-xxx"
Tip:
Do not screenshot your Key in public groups. Get a free/cheap Key (e.g. GLM-4, DeepSeek) to practice.

Step: Start and run your first task
Run the example command from the project and watch the terminal output.
Code:
./run.sh
Check:
If the program prints results (no red Error text), you have it working.

Step: Troubleshooting
Failing the first local deploy is normal. Common issues:
1. Dependency version mismatch → use the Python/Node version the repo recommends;
2. Key not working → check your environment variables;
3. Cannot reach the model API → switch mirror or provider.
Tip:
See more examples in "Related tutorials" below, or click "Visit official site".
tools.detail: GIMP AI is a suite of AI plugins designed to enhance the capabilities of the popular open-source image editing software, GIMP. This tool leverages advanced machine learning algorithms to offer a range of features that streamline the image editing process. Key features include automatic object removal, background replacement, and AI-driven color correction. GIMP AI is ideal for graphic designers, photographers, and hobbyists looking to improve their workflow with cutting-edge AI technology. The tool is user-friendly, requiring no advanced technical knowledge, and can be seamlessly integrated into existing GIMP workflows. Pros include its ease of use, integration with GIMP, and the ability to perform complex tasks with minimal effort. Limitations may include a learning curve for some users and potential limitations in handling very high-resolution images.
